package.name: bev_mapper
package.description: Bird's-eye-view occupancy map from SLAM-registered Livox scans (/registered_scan + /state_estimation). The map/frontier code is copied verbatim from Navigation-Physical-Experiment/src/vlm_nav_bridge; only the thin ROS wrapper (bev_mapper_node.py) is new. Publishes an OccupancyGrid, a robot-centred BEV image and frontier centres; never steers the robot.
